The shared note suggests consecutive chunks, but the example assert is the spec. It expects round-robin distribution: sublist `i` takes every `n`th element starting at index `i`. The slice `lst[i::n]` produces exactly that, and I checked it by hand against the 14-element example.

```python
def list_split(lst, n):
    return [lst[i::n] for i in range(n)]
```

CONFIDENCE: 95
